entries.claim: The round-2 edit to Task 2 makes Task 2 edit eslint.config.js, but Task 6's Verify still requires `git diff c530a6e3 HEAD -- ... eslint.config.js ...` to print nothing, so the two tasks now contradict each other.
entries.failure_scenario: Task 2 runs as written: it adds the `!.github/cadence/coverage-report-check.mjs` negation and the `.github/cadence/**/*.mjs` node-globals block. Task 6 then runs `git diff c530a6e3 HEAD -- scripts/gates/testing/check_coverage_floor.py pyproject.toml .pre-commit-config.yaml eslint.config.js .jscpd.json knip.json`. The diff is non-empty, so Task 6's Verify fails even though the plan is correct. The executor either stops the phase or has to override the check by hand, and that weakens the AC5 no-exemption proof that this bullet is meant to give.
